title: Built an open-source phishing forensics engine with 98.32% accuracy and zero egress architecture
description: This content describes an open-source phishing forensics engine named phish-zero that claims 98.32% accuracy and operates with a zero-egress architecture to avoid leaking corporate click data. It uses local neural phishing detection, character n-gram TF-IDF vectorizers, and flags for TLD abuse. The post is a community share on Reddit and includes a link to the GitHub repository. There is no indication of a security vulnerability or active threat associated with this tool itself.

references.title: Reddit Discussion: Built an open-source phishing forensics engine with 98.32% accuracy and zero egress architecture

aiSummary: The shared content presents phish-zero, an open-source phishing forensics tool designed to detect phishing attempts locally without querying external APIs, thereby maintaining data privacy. It employs machine learning techniques such as neural phishing detection and character n-gram TF-IDF vectorization, along with TLD abuse flagging, to identify phishing. The tool features a monochrome UI and is intended for forensic analysis rather than being a vulnerability or exploit.
aiImpact: No direct security impact or vulnerability is described. The tool is intended to improve phishing detection and forensic capabilities without exposing sensitive data externally. There is no indication of exploitation or risk introduced by this software.
